summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Mastech Digital, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.

## Mastech Digital, Inc. to Discuss Second Quarter Financial Results on August 13, 2025


July 31, 2025


[PDF Version](https://investors.mastechdigital.com/node/11231/pdf)


PITTSBURGH, Pa.


, July 31, 2025


/PRNewswire/ -- Mastech Digital, Inc. (NYSE American: MHH), a leading provider of Digital Transformation IT Services, has scheduled a conference call to discuss the results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2025. The conference call will occur on Wednesday, August 13th, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time and will be hosted by Mr. Nirav Patel, CEO, and Mr. Kannan Sugantharaman, CFO.


The conference call can be accessed through a listen-only dial-in number or through a live webcast. To listen to the conference call, please dial 877-269-7756. The webcast will be available at[http://www.mastechdigital.com](http://www.mastechdigital.com/) via the Investors section. Investors should log on 10 minutes prior to the start of the program.


A replay of the call will be available for 7 days following its conclusion. Callers can access the replay by dialing 877-660-6853 or 201-612-7415 and entering the access ID 13753809. The webcast will be available for 7 days on Mastech Digital's corporate website.


**About Mastech Digital, Inc.:**


Mastech Digital (NYSE American: MHH) is a leading provider of Digital Transformation IT Services. The Company offers Data Management and Analytics Solutions, Digital Learning, and IT Staffing Services with a digital-first approach. A minority-owned enterprise, Mastech Digital is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA, with offices across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and India.
